people.name: Issachar
people.line: Son of Jacob and Leah, forefather of tribe

people.name: Leah
people.line: Wife of Jacob; mother of six sons and Dinah

translations.web: Leah said, “God has given me my hire, because I gave my servant to my husband.” She named him Issachar.
translations.bsb: Then Leah said, “God has rewarded me for giving my maidservant to my husband.” So she named him Issachar.
translations.kjv: And Leah said, God hath given me my hire, because I have given my maiden to my husband: and she called his name Issachar.
translations.asv: And Leah said, God hath given me my hire, because I gave my handmaid to my husband: and she called his name Issachar.
